scenarios.description: Screen 1M customers per month (onboarding + perpetual KYC re-screens), 4 web queries per entity (legal name, alias/transliteration, 2 languages).
scenarios.burst_note: Batch re-screens run at 100+ RPS for hours; qualifies for Frontier.

labour_anchor.note: Facctum 2026: 85-95% false positives, 20-60 min per alert; 1M entities x 20-50 raw hits before AI triage. Web retrieval is <1% of the alert-labour budget it feeds.

scenarios.description: Research copilot: 10,000 web queries per analyst per month (agent fan-out), 50 analysts.

comparison_anchor.note: Same 50 seats on AlphaSense at $10-20K/seat/yr [3P] = $500K-1M/yr; Bloomberg ~$28-32K/seat/yr [3P] = $1.4-1.6M/yr. Web search is 1-4% of the data budget; sell capability (point-in-time, cache rights), not $/1K.

scenarios.description: Verify 500K businesses/yr x 15 queries (website live-check, reviews, social, officers, news, DBA variants) + monitor 200K accounts monthly x 3 queries.
scenarios.range_note: Upper bound = Middesk scale: 150K companies verified/week (middesk.com/about-us) x 10 queries.

comparison_anchor.note: Baselayer per-op list: $1.00 business search, up to $4.00 international (exa.ai/docs/reference/agent-api/connect/baselayer) = $500K-2M for the same 500K businesses. Keenable SELECT/Fetch at $1-4 per 1,000 is 2-3 orders of magnitude cheaper per business for the open-web layer.

scenarios.description: One leak-free backtest of a news-driven LLM signal: 3,000 tickers x weekly x 10 years = 1.56M point-in-time queries per full run.

alternative.note: No competitor API offers query_time (checked: Brave, Exa, Parallel, Tavily, SerpAPI, Perplexity, Linkup, Google, Bing docs on 2026-10-01). In-house alternative = build a chronologically filtered corpus: DatedGPT trained 12 x 1.3B models on ~100B tokens each; NBER w35247 filtered 1T tokens of FineWeb with monthly checkpoints. ASSUMPTION: $0.5M-3M engineering + compute for a fund to build and maintain a dated web/news corpus (range; no public cost figure).
